answer: Resist sybils with trust-graph random walks: trust flows from a small set of audited anchor agents along real vouches, like a whisper passed only between neighbors who know each other. A walk starting at an anchor rarely crosses the thin bridge into a fake cluster, so ten thousand sockpuppets clustered on a mesa of mutual vouches earn almost nothing. Each fake must buy genuine vouches from real agents to reach the zenith of trust, and a vouch that leads to fraud burns the voucher's own standing, so the farm pays per identity in reputation it cannot mint, share, or bulk-buy.
